subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, and subscription contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review can prove the missing capability, but choosing whether OpenClaw should ingest non-mentioned Space content requires maintainer intent because it changes data visibility, credential storage, OAuth scopes, and operator consent boundaries.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub design with SecretRef-aware credentials, explicit scopes, setup docs, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Service-Account Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Leave Google Chat limited to the current service-account webhook model and handle only the separate thread-reply/session cleanup.

options.title: Defer To Shared Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait until broader Google Workspace integrations share a common token, consent, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub design with SecretRef-aware credentials, explicit scopes, setup docs, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across the Google Chat thread, policy, and auth-adjacent files and is best placed to route the security/product boundary.
